verdict.rationale: Cerebras has a dedicated Structured Outputs capability page stating that it constrains model responses to a JSON schema so applications can process the generated data reliably. That is the core of this story. The evidence is a single one-line doc excerpt, though, with no detail or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: details on strict schema enforcement and supported schema features or limits, any grammar-based constraint option, per-model support coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration that outputs parse reliably.
